title_zh: 习近平为国家最高科学技术奖获得者颁奖并发表重要讲话
title_en: Xi Jinping Presents State Highest Science and Technology Awards and Delivers Important Speech
summary_zh: 8日，习近平总书记在国家科学技术奖励大会等会议上为国家最高科学技术奖获得者颁奖并发表重要讲话，赞颂科技工作者的贡献。
summary_en: On the 8th, President Xi Jinping presented the State Highest Science and Technology Awards and delivered a speech praising the contributions of scientists at several major science and technology conferences.
